description: This file defines a C++ interface (struct INativeJS) for interacting with NativeJS plugins within the WPEFramework. It declares methods for initializing, creating, running, and terminating NativeJS applications, as well as retrieving existing applications. The interface inherits from Core::IUnknown and uses JSON annotations for serialization.

classes.name: INativeJS
classes.description: An interface for managing NativeJS applications within the WPEFramework, including initialization, application creation, execution, and termination.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the specified Wayland display.

methods.name: CreateApplication
methods.description: Creates a new NativeJS application with specified options and outputs the assigned application ID.

methods.name: RunApplication
methods.description: Runs an existing NativeJS application given its ID and URL.

methods.name: RunJavaScript
methods.description: Runs a JavaScript code snippet within the context of a specified application ID.

methods.name: GetApplications
methods.description: Retrieves information about all existing NativeJS applications.

methods.name: TerminateApplication
methods.description: Terminates the application with the specified ID.
